import json
T=[[0]*6 for _ in range(6)]
for c in range(5): T[1][c]=2
for r in range(1,4): T[r][0]=2
for r in range(5): T[r][2]=3
T[1][2]=6
sizes=[4,4,4,4,4,3]
out=[]
for tr,h in enumerate(sizes):
 for _ in range(h):
  row=[]
  for tc,w in enumerate(sizes):
   row += [T[tr][tc]]*w
   if tc<5: row.append(8)
  out.append(row)
  # separator after each tile row except last, placed after full tile block below
 if tr<5: out.append([8]*28)
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
